verdict.rationale: Adyen Protect has a rule builder for creating and backtesting custom rules. Each payment event goes through risk evaluation that automatically blocks, allows, or sends the transaction to review, so rule-triggered actions on events exist, but only within fraud and risk management. Webhooks only notify your server; they do not define rules that execute actions. Missing for 10: general-purpose event-to-action rules beyond fraud decisions, documentation of rule conditions and configurable action types, any programmatic or AI-agent way to define rules, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Create, backtest, and label custom rules with a rule builder interface
Each payment goes through a risk evaluation. The risk evaluation reaches a decision that results in an action to block, allow, or review the transaction.
